_comment: Model capabilities, the FALLBACK for what a node does not report yet (i226 decision 3). The model's weights declare its context ceiling (GGUF <arch>.context_length, HF config max_position_embeddings); the node reports it from the model it serves (heartbeat model_stats[].context_length; Ollama today, noomesh-internal i285) and that report wins. This table caps the window harness placement judges a kind against only where no node reports it: vLLM and llama.cpp placements, and agents older than the report. Each row's `match` globs are tried against the placement's model id, lower-cased, with any registry or org prefix up to the last '/' removed; the first row that matches wins. A model with no row is unknown: no ceiling is assumed, so nothing is refused for it. `max_context` is the model's own context ceiling in tokens; `evidence` says where the number was read. `kv_bytes_per_token` is the cache one token costs per slot, MEASURED on a running daemon; the chat-context memory fit (gateway chat_context.rs, i802) uses it where present instead of placement_fit's conservative fallback. A row with `kv_source.basis` "derived" is computed from the model's own GGUF metadata (layers, kv heads, head dim, K+V, f16) kept in tests/fixtures/model_kv/ollama_gguf_metadata.json, and tests/test_model_kv_rows.py recomputes it; a derived figure is the FULL-attention one (sliding windows and shared layers are not credited), so it is never below the truth. Every model onboard can pick has such a row. Derived rows match their exact tag, not a prefix, so a quantised variant of another size never takes them.

models.evidence: text_config.max_position_embeddings of google/gemma-4-12B-it-qat-w4a16-ct and gemma4.context_length of Ollama gemma4:12b, both 262144, read on node-a 2026-10-27; kv_bytes_per_token derived, not guessed: GGUF header of Ollama gemma4:12b (sha256:bb722270d543), gemma4.block_count 48, attention.head_count_kv per layer, [1, 8], key/value length per layer type, summed over the layers x (K + V) x 2 bytes (f16); copy of the fields in tests/fixtures/model_kv/ollama_gguf_metadata.json, read 2026-11-20

kv_source.margin: full attention: every layer charged for the whole context, none cut to its 1024-token window, none shared (0 layers share KV), K and V both charged; f16 even when OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE is q8_0/q4_0 (placement_fit scales it down per row)

models.evidence: kv_bytes_per_token measured by fa on the default one-box cell, CPU, 0.6.24: 13-16 KiB per token per slot from the container cgroup across num_ctx 4096/8192/16384 at OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL 1 and 4 (install-matrix run 43628426011; i802). 16 KiB, the top of the range, is used so the fit errs safe. No max_context: the node reports it (131072).
